name: BoxBorder
description: Draws its parent Stroke over the CSS border ring of the given sides of the box that paints it.

sides.description: Bit mask of painted sides: 1 top, 2 right, 4 bottom, 8 left.

style.description: The border's style on its sides: 0 solid, 1 dashed, 2 dotted. Dashes and dots are sized from each side's border width and fitted to each side's length (to the whole centre line on a rounded box) as Chrome fits them.
